archetype: 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) modified with B2B Enterprise Colors
design_philosophy: Industrial, reliable, and clinically clean. A 'Control Room' interface for office users combined with an ultra-accessible, high-contrast 'Bento' interface for touch production screens. Rejects the generic AI-slop SaaS look by utilizing rigid, Swiss-style grids paired with the specific Azzurro/Celeste/Indaco requested palette.

typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' variant adapted for Enterprise. Expressive/structured Sans for Headings, sterile/functional Mono-like Sans for Body data.

scales.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-bold

office_dashboard.strategy: Dense 'Control Room' grid. Utilize 1px solid borders (border-slate-200) instead of heavy shadows for a cleaner, data-focused look. No rounded corners beyond 8px (rounded-lg).

production_touch.strategy: Massive touch targets. High contrast. Bento layout. Typography scaled up by 1 step. Minimized inputs, rely on large icon buttons (Scan, Start, Pause, QA Fail).

mobile_logistics.strategy: Mobile-first vertical stack. Bottom navigation bar. Large swipeable cards for pickup/delivery tasks. High-contrast mapping overlays.

buttons.primary: bg-indaco text-white hover:bg-indaco/90 hover:text-white rounded-md font-medium px-4 py-2 transition-all shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-slate-900 border border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-50 hover:text-indaco rounded-md font-medium px-4 py-2 transition-all
buttons.touch_primary: bg-azzurro text-white rounded-xl shadow-lg active:translate-y-1 h-32 md:h-48 text-2xl font-bold flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4 transition-transform
buttons.touch_danger: bg-danger text-white rounded-xl shadow-lg active:translate-y-1 h-32 text-2xl font-bold flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-4

cards.office: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-6 shadow-sm
cards.kanban_ticket: bg-white border-l-4 border-l-indaco border-y border-r border-slate-200 rounded p-4 shadow-sm cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing hover:border-r-indaco

navigation.sidebar: w-64 bg-slate-900 text-white flex flex-col border-r border-slate-800
navigation.sidebar_item: flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium rounded-md hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-celeste transition-colors
navigation.touch_header: h-20 bg-indaco text-white flex items-center justify-between px-8 text-xl font-bold shadow-md

tracking_timeline.style: Vertical steps. Active step uses bg-azzurro pulse. Completed uses bg-emerald-500. Pending uses bg-slate-200. Text must maintain APCA contrast.

data_tables.style: w-full text-sm text-left. Header bg-slate-50 text-slate-500 font-bold uppercase tracking-wider. Rows border-b border-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-50/50.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette requested by the user: Azzurro (#0EA5E9), Celeste (#38BDF8), Indaco (#4F46E5). Never use generic blue, purple or teal.

The app MUST have 3 distinct interface modes: Office Dashboard (dense data, sidebars), Production Touch (large buttons, high contrast, kanban boards), Mobile Logistics (vertical cards, map overlays). Build distinct routing for these (e.g., /office, /production, /mobile).
For the Office Dashboard, use a dense 'Control Room' grid style. Charts and tables should fill their containers with minimal padding.

For the Production Touch interface, ensure touch targets are at least 64px tall (p-6/p-8). Use Phosphor Icons at 32px or 48px sizes for clear visual cues. Do not use complex tables on Touch mode, use large Kanban-style cards.
Install and use `@phosphor-icons/react` for icons as it best fits the dense dashboard and industrial aesthetic.
Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' for all headings. Use 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text, numbers, and data tables to ensure tabular numeral alignment. Load these via Google Fonts.
Use Shadcn UI extensively, but strip rounded corners to max 8px (rounded-lg) for an industrial look. Replace Shadcn's default borders with border-slate-200.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements for automated testing (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').
Never use generic lorem ipsum where real domain language works (e.g., use 'Lotto #4892 - Lenzuola Matrimoniali', 'Cliente: Hotel Excelsior').
For the Timeline Traceability component (ritirato -> ricevuto -> ... -> consegnato), build a custom horizontal or vertical stepper using semantic colors.
